content:
The Workshop “How Circular Economy can accelerate R&D in the AEC sector” organised by BUILT CoLAB and FI Group took place on 19 May.

This was the last workshop of a cycle that has been organised within the scope of the Roadmap for Research & Development in the AEC sector, of the FoC – Future of Construction project. This cycle of workshops, with a total of four sessions, focused on specific trends in the sector – Digitalisation, Decarbonisation, Circular Economy and Modularity – with several leading Portuguese business entities invited to present success stories.

For those who did not have the opportunity to attend, the videos of the event are now available on BUILT CoLAB’s YouTube channel:

. Digitalizing

. Decarbonisation

. Circular Economy

. Modularity

More information about this project at https://futureofconstruction.pt/.
